section_summary: This section contains the concluding portions of the U.S. Embassy in Tokyo's Monthly Political Report for Japan for June 1934, along with appended monthly lists of despatches and telegrams. The report reviews Japanese diplomatic challenges, the impending collapse of the Saito Cabinet precipitated by the Kuroda financial corruption scandal, and political stances within the Army, Navy, and major political parties. It also details military aviation expansion, planned grand naval maneuvers, national budget controversies, agricultural distress and the silk cocoon crisis, South American trade initiatives, and Korean emigration to Manchuria. The final pages comprise chronological registers of despatches forwarded and telegrams exchanged by the Embassy during late May and June 1934.

subfiles.about: Continuation and conclusion of the Tokyo Embassy's Monthly Political Report for Japan for June 1934, reviewing internal politics, military and naval policies, financial conditions, foreign trade, and appended registers of Embassy despatches and telegrams.
subfiles.summary: This document concludes the Tokyo Embassy's comprehensive Monthly Political Report for June 1934. It evaluates Japanese diplomatic relations and the political crisis facing Prime Minister Saito's administration following corruption revelations surrounding Vice-Minister of Finance Kuroda, alongside potential cabinet successors and party maneuvers. Military sections outline War Minister Hayashi's planned three-year aviation expansion program, upcoming joint maneuvers in Manchukuo, the resignation of Rear Admiral Sakano, and plans for extensive autumn grand naval maneuvers. Economic and social sections detail Finance Minister Takahashi's budget-balancing efforts, naval appropriation demands for the 1935–1936 'crisis year', government relief measures for devastated silk cocoon farmers, commercial negotiations across South America, and Korean emigration schemes, concluding with registers of Embassy despatches forwarded and telegrams transmitted during late May and June 1934.
subfiles.title: Monthly Political Report for Japan - June 1934
